column1: # UI lane 2026-09-26, BUG: tutorial caption advance.
# PR_FONTBORDER=1 on a MesNew makes LiveMaker lay that box out on a FULL-WIDTH advance per glyph,
# so English is letter-spaced and takes ~2x the width. index<TAB>PROPERTY<TAB>old<TAB>new.
# FIX1 2026-09-26 (F6, F15): tutorial body. PR_FONTCHANGEABLED unset = full-width advance for Latin; 0 = proportional
# (in-game A/B test work/_fix1/shots/compare_ABCD.png; face and border are not the lever on this box).
# FIX3 2026-10-29 (friend report, synopsis clipped): the scenario-synopsis boxes (main body idx 3779, route boxes
# 3773/3776) had PR_FONTCHANGEABLED unset = full-width advance for Latin, so English wrapped at ~2x the lines and ran
# off the 500 px box ("New Route" cut). Same cure as idx 1123.
# FIX4 2026-11-05 (on-screen smoke test r2, lane1/test-r2/510.png): navigator right-click menu, Config rows. The English
# labels at x=261 run into the "Low" captions at x=372 ("Ambient sound" ink ends at 426, "Sound effects" at 418;
# MS P Mincho bold 25 px). Labels 30 px left (231 = 18 px after the Load / Rename buttons, which end at 213); the
# Low caption + slider + High caption move 56 px right together (High now ends ~678 of the 712 px panel; the Title
# screen button ends at 696). Same objects, same rows; only PR_LEFT changes. 00001923 (in-scene menu) has no overlap.
# 2026-11-23 friend report: the scenario-change warning (idx 1533) sat right of centre and touched the right edge.
# The caption has no width; HALIGN=1 centres lines on the widest one, which starts at PR_LEFT. English is now 3 lines
# (widest 475 px in MS PMincho 30, tools/fit_gdi.py) -> left (960-475)/2 = 242; top 15 px up so the 3-line block keeps the old middle.
# idx 1535 (no-scenario-left notice, widest line 667 px) had the same cause: left (960-667)/2 = 146.
# 2026-11-23 friend report: the top info bar (Caption 現情報, shown when the mouse is at the top edge) ran off the
# right edge. It has no font name, so it uses the default face; in English 66 of 516 bars (scenarios + references)
# were wider than 960 px with the pinned marker. Segoe UI 16 (narrow Windows UI face, tools/fit_gdi.py): widest bar
# 854 px, none over. Every word kept. The same caption is created in 0000001C idx 4460 and 00001F8A idx 340.
